title: Fixed Slotted Stock and Rule Combination Square
description: One newly authored complete static combination-square appearance in a flat display pose. A thick integral stock has a full straight right-angle side and an oblique forty-five-degree-looking opposite bearing face, with a genuine bounded rectangular through-slot crossing its whole width. One long thin chamfer-ended rule passes through that slot, with separate exposed spans on both sides. A fixed side lock spindle and complete broad thumbwheel attach to the stock. Fourteen solid short and long marks on one exposed rule span are illustrative, without units or numbers. The whole stock, slot, rule and lock assembly is newly authored rather than a classroom triangular ring cut apart or a standing height gauge laid down. Three opaque constant PBR materials; one prop zero scenes.
